def create_gsl_matrix(data):
  """
  Create a GSL matrix from a 2D list of floats.
  """
  rows = len(data)
  cols = len(data[0])
  matrix = gsl.gsl_matrix_alloc(rows, cols)
  for i in range(rows):
    for j in range(cols):
      gsl.gsl_matrix_set(matrix, i, j, data[i][j])
  return matrix

def retrieve_gsl_matrix(gsl_matrix):
  """
  Retrieve the elements of a GSL matrix as a 2D list.
  """
  rows = gsl.gsl_matrix_get_size(gsl_matrix, 0)
  cols = gsl.gsl_matrix_get_size(gsl_matrix, 1)
  data = [[0 for _ in range(cols)] for _ in range(rows)]
  for i in range(rows):
    for j in range(cols):
      data[i][j] = gsl.gsl_matrix_get(gsl_matrix, i, j)
  return data

def free_gsl_matrix(gsl_matrix):
  """
  Free the memory allocated for a GSL matrix.
  """
  gsl.gsl_matrix_free(gsl_matrix)
